title: game.paused
description: server → host and clients. The game is paused. While paused: all server timers and slot-hold countdowns are frozen, phones freeze local minigame clocks, and the server rejects pause-blocked messages with PAUSED. Sent on game.pause, when the host connection drops, and in snapshots taken while paused.

reason.description: Why the game is paused. HOST_DISCONNECTED takes precedence when both apply.

atMs.description: Server clock when the pause began.

roomExpiresAtMs.description: HOST_DISCONNECTED: when the room is destroyed if the host does not return (pause start + 10 min); null for HOST_REQUEST.

PauseReason.description: Why the game is paused (§17.7, §13.3 Classroom).

TimeMs.description: Absolute time on the server clock: integer milliseconds since the Unix epoch. Every `…AtMs` field in the protocol uses the server clock (see Clock).
